title: Vibe Coding Case Study: Notes App

sections.heading: Context
sections.body: We build a simple notes app to apply vibe coding. The app supports creating, editing, and organizing notes. It runs on mobile and web with local-first persistence and background sync. Annotations in this book mirror the features we implement.

sections.heading: Beats
sections.body: Beat 1: open app, see last note and a prominent 'New note' action. Beat 2: tap to create and type immediately. Beat 3: autosave and a subtle 'Synced' signal. Beat 4: add a tag chip and see filtered results without a reload.

sections.heading: Loops
sections.body: We define loops for typing, saving, searching, and tagging. Typing acknowledges immediately. Saving is optimistic with a toast and undo. Searching updates results as you type with debounced queries. Tagging uses predictive chips.

sections.heading: Signals
sections.body: Copy is short and warm. Colors encode only status, not decoration. Motion is light: inputs grow slightly on focus; cards fade in on create. Sync status sits in the corner, readable but calm.

sections.heading: Outcomes
sections.body: Users report feeling fast and safe. Task completion times drop by 20%. Undo usage is steady, which indicates risk is handled without hesitation. Support tickets about lost work disappear. The vibe is quiet confidence.

sections.heading: Exercises
sections.body: Fork the case study mentally into your product. Write beats, loops, and signals for one core flow. Implement optimistic UI for the most common action and measure the change.
